purpose: Fixed real-world opening-query observations plus environment-independent navigation acceptance criteria.

environment.scope: one shared root containing the full corpus

provenance.note: Observed hit counts are provenance, not fixed expectations; scope, settings, corpus, retrieval implementation, and limit can change them.

actionable_definition: The response contains a successful executable next-command route even when results is empty.
dead_end_definition: A successful response with neither a result route nor an executable navigation route.
